name: worldjen
description: Agent skills for WorldJen — measurable quality scoring for generated media: install, runner, score (single-clip per-dimension scores), rank (leaderboard across clips that share a prompt), bench (whole-model benchmark), and the public leaderboard.

interface.longDescription: Drive WorldJen from Codex — measurable quality scoring for generated media. Install the SDK and CLI, set up and operate a runner host, score a single generated clip for raw per-dimension numbers, rank clips that share a prompt into a leaderboard, benchmark a whole model across every dimension at scale, and fetch the public leaderboard.
defaultPrompt: Install the WorldJen CLI and verify it works.
Score these 10 videos and tell me which one to ship and why.
Benchmark Lightricks/LTX-2 on all t2v dimensions with runner gpu-h100-01.
Compare run_8a3f to run_91bc — which dimensions regressed by 5pp or more?
